title: Selena Gomez's Sweet London Surprise: Dessert Tray Dance!
summary: Have you ever been so excited about dessert that you just had to dance? Selena Gomez totally gets it. She's in London right now, filming season 6 of her hit show *Only Murders in the Building*. And she started her first week with a super fun video. In the clip, she jumps into a viral trend started by singer Sabrina Carpenter. The trend is all about giving a "house tour" — but instead of rooms, Selena points to different levels of a fancy dessert tray while lip-syncing to Sabrina's song. It's silly, sweet, and will definitely make you smile. This is the first time the show is filming outside the U.S., and fans are buzzing. The last season ended with a big clue about a mystery in the U.K., so London makes perfect sense. Selena shared the video on Instagram with a U.K. flag emoji and a heart. She also posted photos with her co-stars Steve Martin and Martin Short. The show has won seven Emmys since it started in 2021. That's a lot of golden trophies! Selena said she's super grateful to the fans for making season 6 possible. So, next time you see a dessert tray, maybe give it your own "house tour." Just don't knock over the cake!
why_it_matters: Selena's playful video shows that even famous people find joy in simple things like dessert and music, just like you do with your friends.

background_read: Selena Gomez is an American singer and actress who became famous on Disney Channel's 'Wizards of Waverly Place'.
Sabrina Carpenter is another Disney Channel star who now makes pop music and started the 'house tour' trend.
'Only Murders in the Building' is a comedy-mystery TV series on Hulu, and the Emmys are like the Oscars but for television shows.
Article_Structure: WHO: Selena Gomez, an American actress and singer, and her co-stars Steve Martin and Martin Short.
WHAT: She made a funny video using a dessert tray for a viral 'house tour' trend, lip-syncing to a Sabrina Carpenter song.
WHERE: London, England, where the new season of her hit show is being filmed.
WHY: She wanted to share her excitement with fans, especially since the show's mystery is now set in the U.K.

perspectives.description: Loyal viewers love seeing behind-the-scenes fun and feel more connected to the cast, which builds hype for the new season.
Some might worry that posting silly videos while filming could take focus away from the serious work of making a good mystery show.
From a business view, this is a clever way to promote the show and reach Sabrina Carpenter's younger audience on social media.
